narrative: The letter, open. A single folded sheet held flat under your right hand, the ink-stained forefinger at the margin, candlelight on two hands of writing, the lower lines darker and newer than the rest. The letter, open. The same sheet, your thumb moved down, the last sentence cramped in where the paper was almost full.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the letter through, and stayed on the last sentence.
